name: herdr-agent-org-grok
description: Grok agent-org on Herdr substrate. Orchestrator/herdr-worker/replacer/org-audit skills + filesystem board CLI. Dispatches workers via herdr agent start in real panes; coordination over the org-relay MCP bus 1.0 (durable queue + guide-gated messaging tools; the bus is task-backed — MCP tasks/SEP-2663 — for clients that can use it, while grok holds bounded in-call awaits with explicit timeout_s=50 and re-arm; nudge watchdog as last-resort net), herdr agent wait as fallback, org-waker demoted to legacy; no Solo MCP required. The orchestrator self-plans (L3): no planner agent exists in this org. L16 makes lane trees MCP-first (skyline_workspace_create with an absolute from_path, CLI skyrift second, git worktree last) and L17 makes dispatch effort explicit, with dispatch-worker appending --effort medium for grok and refusing an upgrade without --upgrade-reason (marketplace#32). Session discipline hooks (lane mark, conduct refresh, stop gate) use exact ${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT} load-time paths. Requires HERDR_ENV=1 and herdr >= 0.7.
